We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: defendant contracted a renovation project, got 22 million? Actually 22万元 (220,000). He owes workers 57,000. He refused to pay, escaped, but later paid after police case. So crime: refusing to pay labor remuneration? In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "拒不支付劳动报酬" (refusing to pay labor remuneration) which is a specific offense under Article 277 of Criminal Law (maybe). The examples earlier: one case about refusing to execute judgment gave "拒不执行判决、裁定". Another about refusing to pay wages gave "拒不支付劳动报酬". Indeed earlier example: "拒不支付劳动报酬" was answer for a case about employer not paying wages after court order. So here similar: refusing to pay labor remuneration. Also maybe "合同诈骗"? He contracted and took money, but didn't pay workers. He did receive payment from client (22万元) and left, but didn't pay workers. That's more like "拒不支付劳动报酬" rather than fraud. The crime of refusing to pay labor remuneration is separate. So answer: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: He also possibly committed "逃匿" but that's not a crime. He may have "非法占有" but not. So single crime.
